verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 rather than head 5, violating the "remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)" clause and result clauses 1–3: it keeps columns/rows `0..383`, `448..767`, etc., instead of the required `0..319`, `384..767`, ... in each 768-wide segment. All the required shape checks and the 160-tensor count still pass, so the failure is silent — the output has correct shapes but wrong values and would fail the bit-exact grading. Everything else (Conv1D axis choice: axis 1 for `c_attn.weight`, axis 0 for `c_attn.bias` and `c_proj.weight`, the three-segment q|k|v handling, untouched tensors, output path) matches the specification.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
